title: Advano Advances Silicon Anode Production Capabilities at Pilot Facility with Key Leadership Appointments
summary: Advano proudly announces the key additions of COO & CTO as well as final stage of commissioning at its industrial pilot plant in anticipation of production.
body_markdown:
NEW ORLEANS, June 11, 2024 /PRNewswire/—Advano, a next-generation silicon-carbon composite anode material innovator for advanced lithium-ion batteries, proudly announces the final stage of commissioning at its industrial pilot plant in anticipation of production later this month. This milestone achievement is attributed to the vision and expertise of Advano’s recently hired critical operations and technology leaders, Chief Operating Officer, Jim Stonecipher and Chief Technology Officer, Dr. Sung H. Lim.


[(See the original posting on PR Newswire.)](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/advano-advances-silicon-anode-production-capabilities-at-pilot-facility-with-key-leadership-appointments-302169594.html?tc=eml_cleartime)
